scheme_name: AICTE - Grant For Augmenting Infrastructure In North Eastern Region
other_conditions: Institute must be located in the North East region of India.
Institute must have been in existence for at least five years.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹15 lakh for water projects, ₹20 lakh for power/solar projects, and ₹5 lakh for internet connectivity to eligible technical institutes in North East India.
documents_required: Signature and stamp of the Head of the Institute on each page of the application form
